## Purpose of model
The purpose of this model is to understand the drivers of the expected 1-year forward returns of the cash asset class.

This model is specified as:
$$
log(Fed\,Funds\,Rate\,1\,year\,forward) = \beta_0 + \beta_1 \text{Growth} + \beta_2 \text{PCE Inflation} + \beta_3 \text{Unemployment} + \beta_4 \text{Current Fed Funds Rate} + \epsilon_i
$$
```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
## Load libraries
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)

## Import data
Data_Cash <- read_excel("../Data/Cash.xlsx")

```

## Fit the model

```{r, echo=FALSE}
## Fit the model
Cash.lm <- lm(log(FFR_1yr_FWD_ECCBUS) ~ Growth_ECGQUS + PCE_ECPCUS + Unemployment_ECUPUS + Current_Fed_Funds_FDTRMID_Index,
              data = Data_Cash)
summary(Cash.lm)
cat("AIC: ", AIC(Cash.lm), "\n")
cat("BIC: ", BIC(Cash.lm), "\n")

```

## Data exploration: Check for linear relationship between Response (Y) and Predictors (X)

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Scatterplot to check for linear relationships
sp1 <- ggplot(data = Data_Cash, aes(x = Growth_ECGQUS, y = FFR_1yr_FWD_ECCBUS)) + geom_point()
sp2 <- ggplot(data = Data_Cash, aes(x = PCE_ECPCUS, y = FFR_1yr_FWD_ECCBUS)) + geom_point()
sp3 <- ggplot(data = Data_Cash, aes(x = Unemployment_ECUPUS, y = FFR_1yr_FWD_ECCBUS)) + geom_point()
sp4 <- ggplot(data = Data_Cash, aes(x = Current_Fed_Funds_FDTRMID_Index, y = FFR_1yr_FWD_ECCBUS)) + geom_point()
sp1 + sp2 + sp3 + sp4 + plot_layout(ncol = 2, nrow = 2)

```

## Diagnostic Plots

```{r , echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

library(ggfortify)
#autoplot(Cash.lm, which = 1:6, ncol = 3, label.size = 3)
# autoplot(Cash.lm, which = 1, ncol = 1, label.size = 3)
# autoplot(Cash.lm, which = 2, ncol = 1, label.size = 3)
# autoplot(Cash.lm, which = 5, ncol = 1, label.size = 3)
# autoplot(Cash.lm, which = 6, ncol = 1, label.size = 3)

autoplot(Cash.lm, which = 1:2, ncol = 2, label.size = 3)
autoplot(Cash.lm, which = 5:6, ncol = 2, label.size = 3)

library(broom)
lm.data <- augment(Cash.lm)
ggplot(lm.data, aes(x = .fitted, y = .std.resid)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -2, linetype = "dashed")
  

```

## Data exploration: Assess distribution of data

```{r , echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

bp2 <- ggplot(data = Data_Cash, aes(Growth_ECGQUS)) + geom_boxplot()
bp3 <- ggplot(data = Data_Cash, aes(PCE_ECPCUS)) + geom_boxplot()
bp4 <- ggplot(data = Data_Cash, aes(Unemployment_ECUPUS)) + geom_boxplot()
bp5 <- ggplot(data = Data_Cash, aes(Current_Fed_Funds_FDTRMID_Index)) + geom_boxplot()
bp1 + bp2 + bp3 + bp4 + bp5 +plot_layout(ncol = 2, nrow = 3)

h1 <- ggplot(data = Data_Cash, aes(FFR_1yr_FWD_ECCBUS)) + geom_histogram()

```
